a('Q001','For each held office card, roll one die simultaneously; add 1 per fatigue on that card, and the Chairman adds 1. Modified 1–2: nothing; 3–4: add fatigue; 5+: retire. a('Q003','At phase start check whether the opportunity marker already matches the selected main action; if so, that main action may be taken twice. Then move the marker to the chosen main action. a('Q005','Fill vacancies in ascending number on card backs. The designated hirer chooses a candidate.
